  all   agents
 Keyboard & search
 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 Navigate                                                     Search syntax
   ↑/↓, ctrl+k/ctrl+j     move                                  api web         both terms (space is AND)
   ctrl+u/ctrl+d          half page up/down                     api|web         either term (OR)
   pgup/pgdn              scroll the preview                    'api            exact text, closing quote optional
   ←/→, ctrl+h/ctrl+l     collapse/expand                       "api gw"        exact phrase ('api gw' too)
   tab/shift+tab          next/previous view                    ^back           starts with
   ctrl+b                 next blocked agent                    end$            ends with
                                                                ^shep$          the whole text is exactly
 Act                                                            /v[0-9]+/       regular expression
   enter                  open the highlighted row              !test           exclude matches
   ctrl+t                 open as a tab here                    !^tmp           negation works with every form
   ctrl+p                 open as a pane here                   status:working  agent status: idle working blocked done
   ctrl+f                 pin/unpin                                             unknown
   ctrl+x                 close the open Herdr item (y/n        agent:claude    agent name contains
                          when configured)                      source:zoxide   source: herdr workspaces zoxide
   ctrl+e                 rename the open Herdr item                            projects sessions agents, or a custom
   ctrl+n                 new worktree of this repo                             name
                                                                path:allsafe    path contains
 Search                                                         s:blocked       short forms s: a: src: p:
   type                   filter the list
   backspace              delete a character
   ctrl+w, alt+backspace  delete a word
   esc                    clear search, then quit

 Layout
   ctrl+r                 show or hide the preview

 Session
   ctrl+c, ctrl+g         quit
